support.request_quote: Hey there! I'll be landing in Los Angeles on December 15th and I'm looking to rent a car for a week. Can you help me find some car rental companies in LA that have SUVs available? Also, could you recommend me the one with the highest rating? Just let me know the company name and its rating. Thanks a bunch!
support.reason: The highest-rated eligible LA SUV company is identified by filtering companies in Los Angeles with SUV availability and selecting the unique maximum rating among them. SunSet Rent-A-Car and LAX Car Rental have SUVs available in Los Angeles, with ratings 4.5 and 4.1 respectively. SunSet Rent-A-Car has the highest rating 4.5.
